excerpt: The SNO detector is located at 46 28' 30'' N, 81 12' 04'' W in the INCO, Ltd., Creighton mine near Sudbury, Ontario, Canada. The center of the detector vessel is 2039 m below the surface ... The granitic rock overburden (mainly norite) corresponds to approximately 6000 m water equivalent.
publisher: SNO Collaboration / Nuclear Instruments and Methods A
title: The Sudbury Neutrino Observatory, Nucl. Instrum. Meth. A449 (2000) 172-207
